[[File:Predator_interdiction_drive.png|thumb|right|200px|A Predator interdiction drive]]
The '''Predator interdiction drive''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Predator drive was capable of emitting a powerful interdiction field for a brief period of [[Time/Legends|time]], slowing down all nearby ships.
